external_entities.name: reader
external_entities.description: A person who accesses the public site and fetches assets from the CDN; some readers are signed in.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Public site: readers hit the web server over HTTPS, some of them signed in.

external_entities.name: admin
external_entities.description: A person who maintains the database directly.
external_entities.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS.
external_entities.notes: The admin connects from wherever they happen to be.

external_entities.name: CDN
external_entities.description: The content delivery network from which readers fetch images, stylesheets, and downloads.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

processes.name: web server
processes.description: Serves the public site, runs the CMS, accesses the MySQL database, and pushes newly published assets to the CDN's bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database on the same hosted network.

processes.name: CMS
processes.description: The content management system running on the web server.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS

data_stores.name: MySQL database
data_stores.description: Stores pages, accounts, and comments for the CMS and is maintained directly by the admin.
data_stores.source_excerpt: keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database on the same hosted network.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I could not tell you whether the database is encrypted on disk."

data_stores.name: CDN bucket
data_stores.description: The CDN bucket to which the web server pushes newly published images, stylesheets, and downloads.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket.

data_flows.data_description: Public site content and sign-in interactions

data_flows.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

data_flows.name: publish assets
data_flows.description: The web server pushes newly published assets to the CDN bucket.

data_flows.name: maintain database
data_flows.description: The admin directly maintains the MySQL database rather than using the CMS.

data_flows.notes: The connection is described as unsecured, with no TLS, and there is no jump host.
